lemmas.statement: Within the declared bounds (fifteen rounds, node guard 250 per run, growth below four data, two items) and under the literal reading of carrying forward, four engines carry the grammar forward declaring the stake and not the stream (SD-R-11). This is a bounded computation, neither a floor proof nor a reduction.
The count of declared inputs has a floor of two. No proof exists, and the count stays two (D10, H-1).

near_misses.claim: The four bounded one-input carriers show that the declared-input floor is one, or that the floor proof is reduced.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The carriers are a computation at declared bounds only. Whether they carry forward past those bounds is OPEN (H-1), and the count stays two.

near_misses.claim: The completion-gate clause is settled in favour of one reading of the bounded one-input carriers.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The clause admits two readings and was frozen as NOT_ESTABLISHED. The author approved the freeze without a separate ruling.

open_obligations: No @SRC or @KNOWN+ declarations were provided, so no generators, relations or compositions could be grounded.
A floor proof for the declared-input count is missing (D10, H-1).
The responder is not yet in Lean, and H-1 needs it.
It is not known whether the four one-input carriers carry forward past the bounds (fifteen rounds, node guard 250, growth below four data, two items).
The other reading of the completion-gate clause is unruled, and the author has not made a separate ruling.
